oracle.evidence: no independent decider named. Until one is, any precision figure for this rule is OUR opinion of our own output — a hand-rolled timing classifier scored no-redos at 28.6% where recheck scored the identical patterns at ~96%
oracle.command: see ANALYSIS-LIMITS.md and the oracle column in RULE-SCORES.md

effectiveFp.evidence: never measured. Technical FP is not effective FP: a finding counts against us when it is wrong, AND when it is right but nobody would act on it. Bar is 5% for anything a preset enables

reachability.evidence: the rule's default contract is not asserted. A rule enabled by default must report only when it can resolve a path from an untrusted source; "report unless proven safe" is a different product and belongs opt-in

corpus.evidence: MANIFEST.md: written against code designed to break the claim that the heuristic was replaced by evidence, testing both directions of the original — its over-reporting of `arr[i]` and its under-reporting of non-identifier keys.

duel.evidence: 14 TP / 0 FP / 0 FN — 100.0% precision, 100.0% recall, 100.0% F1

partition.evidence: PROBED 2026-08-18. `target[req.body.key] = req.body.value` draws exactly one report, from this rule. The CWE-915 siblings are ORM-specific and model a different sink.
partition.command: npx tsx scripts/probe-rule.mts secure-coding/detect-object-injection -- 'function h(req, target){ target[req.body.key] = req.body.value; }'

throughput.evidence: attributed to the rule's own frames: 10x 7.48ms (152 samples) · 20x 10.03ms (232 samples) · 40x 15.87ms (382 samples) · 80x 23.82ms (651 samples) — 1.70x cost for 2.0x work (40x→80x), linear or better

recorded.evidence: rule last changed 2026-08-20 · RULE-SCORES.md stamp 2026-08-18 · BENCHMARK-RESULTS.md stamp 2026-08-18

knownGaps.summary: The rule's marginal CPU cost clears the noise floor at 8000 lines only, so no growth curve can be read.
knownGaps.why: Harness cost at that size is ~70ms and the rule contributes ~11ms; at 500 and 2000 lines the difference between two parser-dominated timings is smaller than the run-to-run variance. The property is decidable, the instrument is not sharp enough.
knownGaps.reopenWhen: a CPU profile attributing samples to the rule’s own frames exists, or the sizes are raised until two points clear the floor
